english: 128 The Chronography of Bar Hebraeus.

And after these things Mahdi went up against the land of the Romans,
and encamped on the river Puramon {OCR?} in the region of Arabissus.
And his son Harun conquered the fortress of Semalos {OCR?}, took captives and came out.
And in the year 1092
of the Greeks, the Arabs took captive from Ephesus about seven thousand;
and of the Arabs also four thousand died.
Then Leo the king sent an army and exiled the people of the orthodox, the Syrians,
and settled them in Thrace.
And it is said
that this Leo the king also was a hater of images and cleaved to the orthodox, like his father.
And in that year Leo died,
and Constantine his son reigned twenty-two years.
Because he was young when he became king,
his mother Irene was governing and was proclaimed together with him.
In the year 1094
1094 Mahdi sent his son Harun against the royal city.
And the Romans spread out
and shut in the Arabs on the river Sangarius,
with the mountain on one side
and the water on the other side.
And when the Arabs were hard pressed,
they sought peace for three years.
And Irene, with a womanly mind, made peace,
and the Arabs went out.
And after a year Ali built Hadath the city.
After Mahdi, Musa his son, one year and a month and a half.
Before this one reigned,
namely in the year 1095
1095 of the Greeks (784 of our Lord?),
flying locusts came and destroyed the crops,
and laid eggs.
And it came forth and crawled, climbing up walls and houses,
and entering through windows and doors into the houses.
And from it even the water jars and the vessels, tables and dishes were filled.
And when it entered a house from the southern side,
it would come out from the northern side.
And along with the grass and trees it also ate woollen goods and the clothes of people.
And when it had consumed the whole region of Edessa and Serugh,
it passed over to the west.
And three years after this severe chastisement
there was famine in the land.
And in the year 1097
1097 the Romans went out and laid waste Hadath, which had newly been built by the Arabs,
and they destroyed it and overthrew its walls completely.
And in that year Musa died, in the month of Tammuz.
After Musa, Harun al-Rashid his brother, twenty-three years and two months.
This one sent 'Abd al-Malik
and uprooted the church
